node.label: Agnipath & Agniveers
node.summary: The tour-of-duty recruitment scheme for the armed forces below officer rank, and its periodic review.

facts.text: The government clarified **Agnipath is not rolled back**: the 25% retained after 4 years continue as before, while the remaining 75% get a second 2-year engagement, after which all willing and fit Agniveers can join the regular cadre with **protected seniority**.
facts.plain: The government clarified Agnipath is not rolled back: the 25% retained after 4 years continue as before, while the remaining 75% get a second 2-year engagement, after which all willing and fit Agniveers can join the regular cadre with protected seniority.

facts.text: Union Cabinet approved a **two-year additional engagement period** for Agniveers: the **75%** not retained after the initial 4-year term can now serve 2 more years (with higher pay) before being considered for regular enrolment; earlier only up to **25%** per batch were retained. Announced by CDS **Gen. N.S. Raja Subramani**.
